The structure of MgMn2(PO5)2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 22-atom unit cell and seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies P centers as tetrahedral (4 O neighbors) and Mn centers as octahedral (6 O neighbors), while Mg adopts a 10-vertex coordination environment. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Mn octahedra and P tetrahedra, edge-sharing between Mn octahedra, and corner-sharing between Mg and Mn polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 22 sites.
